CqrsLens 0.5.0 - see your MediatR codebase.

Usage: cqrslens <path> [-o OUTPUT] [--format md|html] [--config FILE] [--analysis text|roslyn] [--generated-at ISO8601] [--markers ICommand,IQuery] [--handler-markers ICommandHandler,IQueryHandler] [--baseline FILE] [--write-baseline FILE] [--sarif FILE] [--summary FILE] [--github-annotations] [--ci-root DIR] [--strict]

  <path>        Folder of the .NET solution to scan (searched recursively).
  -o, --output  Report path. Default: ARCHITECTURE.md (or .html) in the current directory.
  --config      Config file. Default: <path>/.cqrslens.json when present.
                Settings: analysis, markers, handlerMarkers, include/exclude globs, layers, rules.
  --format      Report format: md (default) or html. A .html -o path implies html.
  --analysis    Analysis backend: text (default) or roslyn (opt-in).
  --generated-at  Fixed ISO-8601 timestamp for reproducible reports (tests/CI);
                timing is reported as 0 ms in this mode.
  --markers     Comma-separated custom marker interface names that also count
                as request roots (e.g. ICommand,IQuery,IMessage). Requests hidden
                behind interfaces deriving from IRequest are always followed.
  --handler-markers  Comma-separated custom handler roots for external wrappers
                (e.g. ICommandHandler,IQueryHandler). Source-declared wrappers
                are followed automatically.
  --baseline    Compare checks with a baseline file; --strict then fails only
                on errors not present in the baseline.
  --write-baseline  Record current checks as the baseline, then continue.
  --sarif       Also write SARIF 2.1.0 for code scanning.
  --summary     Also write a compact Markdown job summary.
  --github-annotations  Emit file/line GitHub Actions annotations.
  --ci-root     Repository root used to rebase annotation/SARIF paths.
  --strict      Exit with code 4 when architecture checks report an error
                and the scan is complete; incomplete scans report diagnost
